title: The sealed registry
speaker: X GOD
caption: The Daughter's seal was broken.
Inside: a ledger of harvested worlds.
alt: X and his schoolmate Barrett uncover a chained registry inside the moonlit mausoleum.

title: Earthior on the page
speaker: X GOD
caption: Earthior. Marked: extracted.
Ours wasn't the only world they'd taken.
alt: X points to Earthior's entry among several worlds recorded in a ledger of resource extraction.

title: A familiar voice
speaker: NICO · RADIO
caption: X? It's Nico! That tag's from the Furnace.
Their launch records should still be there.
alt: X recognizes his schoolmate Nico's voice on Barrett's radio beside a recovered Furnace shipment tag.

title: Toward the Furnace
speaker: X GOD
caption: They didn't just take my world.
The Furnace might tell us who did.
alt: X secures the shipment clue in his folded worksheet as Barrett watches the distant Furnace beyond the Graveyard.
